mapper.sql: r.id, r.name, r.model, r.subtitle, r.cover_image AS coverImage, r.guide_price AS guidePrice, r.market_price AS marketPrice, r.status, r.main_params AS mainParams, r.release_date AS releaseDate, r.hot_score AS hotScore, r.view_count AS viewCount, r.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, r.compare_count AS compareCount, r.comment_count AS commentCount, r.inquiry_count AS inquiryCount, r.score AS score, r.brand_id AS brandId, r.category_id AS categoryId, b.name AS brandName, b.logo AS brandLogo, c.name AS categoryName
mapper.select: SELECT FROM robot r LEFT JOIN brand b ON b.id = r.brand_id AND b.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN robot_category c ON c.id = r.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.id IN #{id}
